selection_rule: Primeras diez afirmaciones normativas explícitas con cita válida, en el orden fijado antes de la revisión: P1 seis funciones, P2 GOVERN, P3 IDENTIFY, P4 PROTECT, P5 DETECT, P6 RESPOND, P7 RECOVER, P8 AI RMF, P9 integración de riesgos, P10 MAP. Se descartan afirmaciones sin cita y no se sustituyen por resultados favorables.

claims.claim: Las seis funciones centrales del NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 son: GOVERN (GV), IDENTIFY (ID), PROTECT (PR), DETECT (DE), RESPOND (RS) y RECOVER (RC).
claims.quote: There are six CSF Functions: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover.

claims.claim: GOVERN establece que la estrategia, expectativas y políticas de gestión de riesgos cibernéticos se establecen, comunican y monitorean.
claims.quote: • GOVERN (GV) — The organization’s cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored.

claims.claim: IDENTIFY establece que los riesgos cibernéticos actuales se comprenden al entender activos y proveedores.
claims.quote: • IDENTIFY (ID) — The organization’s current cybersecurity risks are understood. Understanding the organization’s assets (e.g., data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, people), suppliers, and related cybersecurity risks enables an organization to prioritize its efforts consistent with its risk management strategy and the mission needs identified under GOVERN.

claims.claim: La función PROTECT establece que se utilizan salvaguardas para gestionar los riesgos cibernéticos de la organización una vez identificados y priorizados los activos y riesgos, con el fin de asegurar esos activos y prevenir o reducir la probabilidad e impacto de eventos adversos.
claims.quote: • PROTECT (PR) — Safeguards to manage the organization’s cybersecurity risks are used. Once assets and risks are identified and prioritized, PROTECT supports the ability to secure those assets to prevent or lower the likelihood and impact of adverse cybersecurity events

claims.claim: DETECT establece que posibles ataques y compromisos cibernéticos se encuentran y analizan.
claims.quote: • DETECT (DE) — Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed. DETECT enables the timely discovery and analysis of anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events that may indicate that cybersecurity attacks and incidents are occurring.

claims.claim: RESPOND establece que se toman acciones respecto a un incidente de ciberseguridad detectado.
claims.quote: • RESPOND (RS) — Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken. RESPOND supports the ability to contain the effects of cybersecurity incidents.

claims.claim: RECOVER establece que los activos y operaciones afectados por un incidente de ciberseguridad se restauran.
claims.quote: • RECOVER (RC) — Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored. RECOVER supports the timely restoration of normal operations to reduce the effects of cybersecurity incidents and enable appropriate communication during recovery efforts.

claims.claim: El NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) define cuatro funciones centrales: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE y MANAGE.
claims.quote: The AI RMF Core uses Functions, Categories, and Subcategories to describe AI outcomes and help manage risks related to AI.

claims.claim: Los riesgos de IA se integran en la gestión de riesgos empresariales al tratarlos junto con otros riesgos críticos como ciberseguridad y privacidad, evitando considerarlos de forma aislada para lograr resultados más integrados y eficiencias organizacionales.
claims.document_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
claims.quote: Treating AI risks along with other critical risks, such as cybersecurity and privacy, will yield a more integrated outcome and organizational efficiencies.

claims.claim: La función MAP (Mapping) establece que se recopila información para prevenir riesgos negativos y fundamentar decisiones iniciales sobre la idoneidad de una solución de IA.
claims.document_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
claims.quote: The MAP function is intended to enhance an organization’s ability to identify risks and broader contributing factors.
